title: A behavior change in one package is made in the other in the same pull request
why:
The JS and the PHP package expose the same API and a user may move between them, so a behavior change in `packages/js/src` or
`packages/php/src` is made in both in the same pull request, with the shared vectors updated where the repository has them (`parity-vectors.json` in safeaccess-identum), and the parity tests pass in both. A parity
test is never edited to make it pass: the divergent behavior is fixed.

Applies to: safeaccess family
Checked by: `npm run test:parity` and `composer test:parity`, both in CI.
alternatives: Port in a later pull request: rejected, the gap is the defect. Let the packages diverge: rejected, it is the one promise the pair makes.
